title: Double Meaning
style: Pop with playful mid-tempo bounce and syncopated guitar chops; verse stays tight and conversational, pre-chorus strips to bass and claps for a teasing lift, chorus opens with stacked harmonies and a chantable hook. Lead vocal is close-mic with crisp doubles, cheeky ad-libs, and short delay throws on punch lines. Ear candy includes reverse swells into the pre, tapped percussion fills, and glockenspiel sparkles between lines. Bright, polished, and catchy.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You say one thing
I hear two
Same sweet sentence
Different view

Your “fine” means fire
Your “sure” means maybe
Little word games
Drive me crazy

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn it around
Flip the key
A tongue can lock
Or set you free

One small phrase
Two whole worlds
Baby, that’s why
I’m hooked on your words

[Chorus]
Word play, word play
Say it again
One line hits twice
And it never ends
Word play, word play
I love that twist
You mean one thing
Then you mean this

Word play, word play
Keep me in the glow
I chase the meaning
You never show
Word play, word play
Don’t let it fade
Your little double
Makes my whole day

[Verse 2]
You call me “cold”
I call that cool
You call it “late”
I call it “rule”

You leave me hints
In half-spun lines
A joke in your mouth
A spark in mine

You bend one word
I lose my mind
Same old sentence
New design

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn it around
Make it ring
A simple phrase
Can change everything

Two ways to read
One grin, one stare
Baby, your meanings
Catch me unaware

[Chorus]
Word play, word play
Say it again
One line hits twice
And it never ends
Word play, word play
I love that twist
You mean one thing
Then you mean this

Word play, word play
Keep me in the glow
I chase the meaning
You never show
Word play, word play
Don’t let it fade
Your little double
Makes my whole day

[Bridge]
Say less, mean more
That’s your art
A loaded phrase
A loaded heart

You split the sound
You flip the room
One little pun
And I bloom
